name: CAPITALA
recent: Capital A 近期持续进行 RCUIDS 转换新股上市，同时执行主席 Datuk Kamarudin 在公开市场增持股份。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比大增 91.5%，但净利同比大跌 98.4%。
notable: 多批 RCUIDS 转换为普通股并上市，涉及数百万新股。
执行主席 Datuk Kamarudin 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日以每股 RM0.215 增持 200 万股。
公司出现清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理相关公告。
risks: RCUIDS 持续转换新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
执行主席在闭市期间表示有意交易公司证券。
出现清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理相关公告，需留意后续发展。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收 RM809.36 million，同比增 91.5%，环比增 5.6%；净利 RM23.87 million，同比降 98.4%，环比增 6.3%；净利率 2.9%。

recent_en: Capital A has been listing new shares from RCUIDS conversions and its Executive Chairman Datuk Kamarudin acquired shares in the open market. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 91.5% YoY but net profit fell 98.4% YoY.
notable_en: Multiple batches of RCUIDS converted into new ordinary shares and listed, involving millions of new shares.
Executive Chairman Datuk Kamarudin acquired 2 million shares at RM0.215 each on 13 Oct 2026.
Announcements related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
risks_en: Ongoing RCUIDS conversions into new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Executive Chairman indicated intention to deal in company securities during closed period.
Announcements on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator warrant monitoring.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM809.36 million, up 91.5% YoY and 5.6% QoQ; net profit was RM23.87 million, down 98.4% YoY but up 6.3% QoQ; net margin 2.9%.
